confirmed.title: Dark theme (stored or OS) is lost after hydration: the desk reverts to light while the toggle says 'Lights on'
confirmed.expected: With localStorage 'alibars-desk'='dark' or OS prefers-color-scheme dark, the dark desk (radial-gradient #34302b/#161513, header ink #e8e4dc) stays after load and the label reads 'Lights on'.
confirmed.actual: The first paint is dark. Hydration then fails with React #418 (text mismatch: the server rendered 'Lights off', but useState(readInitialDark) gives 'Lights on' on the client). React client-renders the root and rewrites the <html> attributes, which removes data-desk and data-intro. The desk falls back to light #d3ccbf with ink #1c1b19, but the label still says 'Lights on', so the user has to click twice to get the dark desk back. The screen also flashes from dark to light.
confirmed.evidence: Playwright on out/ at :5101, stored dark, '/'. Before hydration: data-desk=dark, bg radial-gradient(...), label 'Lights off'. After: data-desk=null, bg rgb(211,204,191), ink rgb(28,27,25), label 'Lights on'. Same result with colorScheme:'dark' and no storage. pageerror: 'Minified React error #418 ... args[]=text'. Screenshot: scratchpad/review-r1/slice-global-pile-intro/post-stored_dark_.png
confirmed.suggestedFix: Make the server and first client render identical. Read the theme after mount (useEffect/useSyncExternalStore with a server snapshot of light), or drive the label from CSS off data-desk. Add suppressHydrationWarning on <html> so a hydration fallback cannot strip the pre-hydration attributes.
confirmed.verifyReasoning: Reproduced on out/ at :5201. With localStorage alibars-desk=dark, and separately with colorScheme dark, the page throws 'Minified React error #418 args[]=text'. After load, data-desk is null, the body background is rgb(211,204,191) with no gradient, and the header button reads 'Lights on'. So the page is light while the label claims dark. Cause: useTheme.ts:25 useState(readInitialDark) reads data-desk during hydration, but the static HTML was rendered with dark=false ('Lights off'). The client render of the root then drops the data-desk and data-intro attributes that the script set on <html>. A light load is clean: data-desk=light and no error.
confirmed.fix: src/lib/useTheme.ts: initialise with useState(false), then sync from document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-desk') in a useLayoutEffect (or use useSyncExternalStore with getServerSnapshot returning false), so the first client render matches the static HTML. In src/app/layout.tsx:57, add suppressHydrationWarning to <html>. Add an e2e test covering both stored-dark and OS-dark loads: check data-desk=dark, the gradient background and the 'Lights on' label, with no pageerror.

confirmed.title: Deep-link and reduced-motion loads throw a React hydration error (#418) and client-render the whole root
confirmed.expected: A deep link (/#racing, /#about, /#cv) or a reduced-motion load hydrates cleanly and starts in phase 'done'.
confirmed.actual: The useState initializer reads window.location.hash and matchMedia during hydration, so the client tree (phase 'done', tabs, no title page) differs from the static HTML (phase 'off', title page). React throws #418 (HTML mismatch), discards the server DOM and re-renders from the root. This also removes data-intro/data-desk from <html> (see slice-01), so the '.js-tabs {opacity:1 !important}' and '.js-title-page {display:none}' pre-hydration guards stop existing. It only works by accident.
confirmed.evidence: Playwright on '/#racing': pageerror 'Minified React error #418; ... args[]=HTML'. After load, document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-intro') === null. Same error on '/' with reducedMotion:'reduce'.
confirmed.suggestedFix: Render the server-equivalent state first ('off', top 'cv') and switch to the deep-link or reduced-motion state in a layout effect. Let the pre-hydration CSS hide the title page until then. Alternatively, render the Pile client-only behind a stable placeholder.
confirmed.verifyReasoning: Reproduced. '/#racing', '/#cv' and a reducedMotion:'reduce' load each throw 'Minified React error #418 args[]=HTML'. Afterwards data-intro and data-desk are both null. usePile.ts:39-43 reads window.location.hash and matchMedia inside the useState initializer, so the first client render ('done', tabs shown, no title page) differs from the static HTML ('off', title page shown). The end state only looks right because React client-renders the whole root. The pre-hydration CSS guards (globals.css:56-64) are gone after that, and the fallback also wipes the stored dark theme (see slice-01).
confirmed.fix: src/lib/usePile.ts: initialise with { top:'cv', phase:'off', moving:null, touched:false }. In a useLayoutEffect on mount, if location.hash maps to a sheet or reduced motion is set, set top from sheetFromHash and phase 'done'. Otherwise schedule the 120ms push. The data-intro='skip' CSS keeps the title page hidden until that effect runs. Together with suppressHydrationWarning on <html> (slice-01), the attributes survive. Add an e2e assertion that no pageerror fires on '/#racing' or on reduced-motion loads.
